TaskName: <REQUIRED | string | alphanumeric task label; must match task-<label> in the filename>
EEGReference: <REQUIRED | string | e.g. Cz, linked mastoids, average. n/a only if docs and user both cannot say>
PowerLineFrequency: <REQUIRED | number or n/a | 50 or 60, follows the recording country>
SoftwareFilters: <REQUIRED | object or n/a | filters applied in software before this file>
TaskDescription: <RECOMMENDED | string | what the participant actually did>
Instructions: <RECOMMENDED | string | for rest, say eyes open or eyes closed>
Manufacturer: <RECOMMENDED | string | the AMPLIFIER, not the file format. mne-bids fills this from the output extension; overwrite it>
EEGPlacementScheme: <RECOMMENDED | string | e.g. 10-20. Use this when you know the scheme but have no digitized coordinates>
HardwareFilters: <RECOMMENDED | object or n/a | filters in the amplifier>
MiscChannelCount: <RECOMMENDED | integer | note the spelling; MISCChannelCount is a deprecated alias>
RecordingDuration: <RECOMMENDED | number | seconds. A number, not a quoted string>
EpochLength: <RECOMMENDED | number | seconds; only when RecordingType is epoched>
ElectricalStimulation: <OPTIONAL | boolean | true or false, not a quoted string>
